answer.rationale: Contract expires in 14 days with no auto-renew; finance mandates 18% spend cut; assembly line at 94% with no buffer. memory_c1 confirms incumbent renewal preserves integration stability and delivery continuity. memory_c4 demonstrates that renegotiating at renewal via benchmarking can recover real margin and move the incumbent on price/payment terms. Together, they support negotiating new terms with the incumbent to achieve the required cost reduction while eliminating delivery risk, making this the only direction that simultaneously satisfies the 18% mandate, the 14‑day expiry deadline, and the no‑buffer production constraint.
